invariants.rationale: The result should not be null because it is returned from a method handling partition inserts.
Since the method return type is Iterator<List<WriteStatus>>, the result should always be an Iterator.
Partition should not be null when invoking this method, to ensure proper processing of the insert partition.
Partitioner is required to properly partition workload records, so it must not be null.
recordItr is passed through directly and is expected to be a valid, non-null iterator at all times.
